projectDescription: An interactive, browser-based monthly operational site brief for Ghana National Gas Company Limited, enabling teams to track project progress, gas flow rates, and department updates — then export to PDF.
keyFeatures: Interactive project progress dashboard with adjustable completion percentages
Gas flow rate register tracking multiple streams (MMscfd) with status indicators
Department update cards covering Community, Roads, Pipeline, Facilities, and Technical Services
In-browser editing — click any text field to update content directly
Local storage save/restore so edits persist across sessions
One-click print and PDF export for formal reporting
publicApiSurface: Gas flow rate table (stream name, flow rate, unit, status, remarks, date)
Department update cards (name, badge, update text, metadata fields)
